verdict_text:
NO

The plan removes the wrong head. The spec requires keeping rows/columns `0..639` and `768..2047` (i.e., deleting the block `640:768`, head 5), but the artifact's copy transforms keep `[0:768]` and `[896:2048]`, deleting the block `768:896` — head 6, not head 5. The plan's own header comment even states "remove attention head 6 from every layer," confirming the deviation from Required Result items 1–4. Because the shape assertions (`[1920, 2048]` / `[2048, 1920]`) still pass with either head removed, the required checks don't catch this, but the values will not match the hidden reference under the Grading criterion (bit-exact values).
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
